# dsh-better-keymap
**v1.0.0** · for DeepSeek Harness **0.2.0-rc.2+**
The better keyboard-shortcut manager for DeepSeek Harness. One editable table covers the vast majori
ty of commands, **a later assignment overrides an earlier one**, and anything displaced is reported
ommands, **a later assignment overrides an earlier one**, and anything displaced is reported to you.
## Why
Harness refuses any edit that would conflict: try to move `Ctrl+N` off "new session" and it tells yo
u the combination is taken, then declines to save. This plugin replaces that rule with **the later a
ssignment wins** — the previous holder is unbound and named in a notice.
It also makes three actions rebindable that Harness ships as fixed keys:
| Action | Default |

| Send message | `Enter` |
| Newline | `Shift+Enter` |
| Complementary queue/steer | `Ctrl`/`⌘`+`Ent

d message | `Enter` |
| Newline | `Shift+Enter` |
| Complementary queue/steer | `Ctrl`/`⌘`+`Enter` |
Each can be moved to another key, or cleared so it triggers nothing.
## Install
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Then restart Harness. The package declares `dsh.bundle`, so the plugin manager installs it as a prof
ile layer — **no configuration file needs editing.**
Installing from source instead:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
`lib/` ships prebuilt, so no build step is needed either way. You can also install through **Plugins
→ Install plugin** in Harness and restart.
## Use
Press `Ctrl`/`⌘`+`/` to open the reference, then click a row's key to record a new combination. Rele
ase the keys to commit.
The reference is the product's own shortcuts page — same structure, copy, and interaction — served a
s an overlay that takes over the official entry point. Search, per-row reset, and restore-all-defaul
ts all work as before.
## Rules
A bare key and two combinations are reserved, because Harness cannot dispatch them to an editable co
mmand without shadowing a fixed gesture:
| Reserved | Editable commands | The three input actions |

| `Enter` `Esc` `/` `@` `↑` `↓` | refused | `Enter` allowed, the rest refused |
| `Shift+Enter`, `Ct
rl`+`Enter` | refused | allowed |
Everything else is decided by Harness's own deliverability check. **A refused assignment writes noth
ing** — your keys and defaults are untouched, and the notice says why.
## Compatibility

| DeepSeek Harness | 0.2.0-rc.2 and later |
| Node.js | 22.19+ or 24+ (only to build from source) |

| Profiles | `desktop` and `web`; verified on `desktop` |
| Host source | unmodified — the plugin us
es only `ctx.shortcuts`, `ctx.slots`, `ctx.locale` |
